review.method: All 185 rendered pages were visually inspected slide-by-slide. PDF text/XML extraction was used only to locate and transcribe code lines; it was not used to decide fixture boundaries. Code panels were normalized against the rendered pages and source ambiguities are recorded per entry.
review.normalization_policy: Code excerpts normalize presentation-only curly single-quote glyphs to ASCII apostrophes, typographic ellipses to three ASCII periods, and typographic dashes inside code to ASCII hyphens. Slide titles retain their printed punctuation.
review.scope: Every textual code panel in the deck, including selected standard-library model slides. Diagram labels and explanatory prose are recorded separately when they resemble code.
review.fixture_policy: fixture_candidate means a closed SysML textual panel without visible ellipsis or an external-language body. It does not claim semantic resolution or parser compatibility; definitions referenced from other slides are listed as context dependencies in notes.
review.runtime_policy: The original PDF is a research source only. Tests should use repository-owned copied fixtures or goldens; never download this PDF or depend on the upstream checkout at test runtime.

known_ambiguities.issue: The closing quote in Package Example is typeset as a right quotation mark; normalized to ASCII in code.
The closing quote in Comment Example is typeset as a right quotation mark; normalized to ASCII in code.
The opaque action body is Alf, not SysML textual notation.
The first import was visually `private import ScalarValues::*;`; the text layer dropped `import` and was corrected.
The calculation examples intentionally use a result expression without a trailing semicolon and mix return-expression forms with a parameter-list form; retained as a non-fixture source panel.
The rendered SI example visibly lacks a semicolon after `referenceUnit = g`; retained and excluded as a fixture candidate.
Typographic quotes around `mi/hr` were normalized to ASCII quotes.
The deck uses typographic single-quote glyphs for many quoted names and operator names; all code excerpts use ASCII apostrophes consistently.

novelty_assessment.interpretation: No complete slide panel is an exact whitespace/typography-normalized duplicate of an existing local PDF ledger entry. Many panels intentionally reuse individual declarations and language patterns from the formal specification; this is not a claim that all panels are semantically novel.

parser_compatibility_gaps.reason: The message panel is a continuation chain whose `then` members require the enclosing context; it is retained as a reviewed source panel rather than silently rejected as a complete root document.
The formal panel uses the legacy comma-separated parameter form; the current SysML-only grammar retains the body `in` member form instead.
